# Walter Liu

> Walter Liu works across IT audit, ITGC, ITAC, IPE, data and interface
> controls, cybersecurity, AI governance and AI assurance.

Walter tests controls, traces evidence and turns recurring audit work into
reusable tools and practical assurance methods.

## Primary pages

- [English homepage](/index.html): Professional focus, knowledge library,
  GitHub work model and contact information.
- [Traditional Chinese homepage](/zh-hant.html): Traditional Chinese version of
  the same professional profile and knowledge-library structure.

## Current focus

- Audit methods: ITGC, ITAC, IPE and sampling.
- Evidence systems: DRLs, populations, testing, findings, management responses
  and quality assurance.
- AI assurance: AI agents, RAG, permissions, logging, model risk and governance.

## Source and limitations

Articles and templates are being published progressively. Content is not legal
advice, a regulatory opinion or a substitute for client-specific professional
judgement.
